$comment: What a rename writes at a place that defines a signal (signalRenameText) or reads it (signalReadRenameText). For a definition, at is the text written at the first declaration that has it, and text is what goes there for rename, or null when nothing written there can define it. For a read, read is the signal a part of an expression's path stands for, and text what goes over that part. Read by SignalRenamesTest.kt and signalRenames.test.ts.

cases.name: a pair is written as it stands
an assignment is written as it stands
a serial name is the annotation's string
cases.src: @Serializable data class S(@SerialName("page_no") val page: Int)

cases.name: a property of a signals class is Kotlin's to rename
an attribute key with capitals is written kebab-case
an attribute key keeps its modifiers and its spelling
an attribute key no spelling gives back is refused
an attribute key holds no path
an object key is the last part of the path
an object key stays under its object
a bare object key that would need quotes is refused
a quoted object key may hold a hyphen
a JSON key in a Kotlin string
a name no expression can read is refused
a read of the signal itself
a read of a signal in an object rewrites its own part
a read keeps its signal under its object
a read of a signal is not turned into a path
